text: Private-constructor final case classes expose a public Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct in Scala3.7.4, so constructor access alone does not enforce invariants. For existing validated case-class products, use sealed abstract case classes with private constructors and companion-private concrete factories (anonymous subclasses). Keep their public fields, generated equality/hashCode/toString, extractors and read-only Product inspection; no public unchecked apply/copy and no constructing Product mirror. Existing plain final validated classes remain valid. Do not introduce reflective or throwing construction mirrors. All recoverable parsing still uses existing smart constructors and typed failures. This deliberately removes unsupported generic construction derivation; codecs and diagnostic rendering that require it must use explicit safe readers/accessors rather than recreating the escape. The language probe proves both generic and concrete consumer mirror rejection, equality, extractor and hash behavior; repository migration requires positive compilation tests so failures cannot be false positives from missing names/imports. Negative tests cover Mirror.ProductOf plus unchecked copy, direct creation and subclassing. Keep binary/codec/API review and full JVM/JS gate per independently landed slice; do not close the house-wide defect until the full candidate inventory is covered. See /private/tmp/eyes4s-mirror-language-probe-20261014/receipt.txt and kernel DomainInvariantSuite for the first concrete slice.
